article.description: The attacks followed Mayor Klitschko's warning of a ballistic missile threat
paragraphs: BG Bulgaria Breaking news Europe Production Videos Politics Business Health Technology Entertainment Sport More Science Weather Opinion Society Conflicts Open Search Menu Close Search Menu Open Menu Close Menu Open Menu Close Menu Breaking news Videos Production Europe Bulgaria Politics Business Health Technology Entertainment Sport Weather Opinion Society Conflicts Science Subscribe Login BG BGNES Conflicts Russian strikes kill nine in Kyiv, injure more than two dozen Russian strikes kill nine in Kyiv, injure more than two dozen 01.08.2026 - 07:28 Share BGNES The attacks followed Mayor Klitschko's warning of a ballistic missile threat --> Russian strikes on the Ukrainian capital killed at least nine people and injured more than 25 others on Saturday, local authorities said, hours after Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko warned of a ballistic missile attack. Ukraine's State Emergency Service said the strikes hit five districts of the city, with four children among the injured. Klitschko wrote on Telegram that Kyiv was under missile attack, urging residents to remain in shelters, while AFP journalists reported hearing more than 10 successive explosions.

The hardest-hit area was the Darnytskyi district, where the strikes damaged numerous buildings and vehicles. Authorities reported seven people killed and 14 injured there. In the Solomianskyi district, two people were killed and eight injured after a strike damaged a five-storey residential building. Rescue teams, seen in photographs searching through the rubble and extinguishing fires, rescued a total of 105 people from the affected areas, according to Ukraine's State Emergency Service.

The attack comes amid an intensification of strikes by both sides in recent months. Russia has stepped up its long-range attacks on Ukrainian cities, while Ukraine has increased its retaliatory strikes, partly in an effort to force Moscow to the negotiating table after nearly four and a half years of war. According to the United Nations, June was the deadliest month for civilians in Ukraine since April 2022.

In a separate development, Russian e-commerce giant Wildberries said on Friday that one of its logistics facilities in Volgograd had caught fire following an overnight attack - the latest in a series of strikes on the company's sites, which Kyiv accuses of storing drone components and supporting the Russian military.

The latest attack also follows this week's meeting between Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and US President Donald Trump, after which Zelensky said Trump had agreed to license the production of Patriot missiles for Ukraine. Trump, however, said on Friday that Washington would have to be "very careful" about granting such a licence. | BGNES, AFP

article.description: ‘He always advised us to remain among the people, for the people, and close to our family, neighbors and mosque,’ Abdul Salam Haniyeh says in interview for 2nd year of his father’s assassination | Anadolu
paragraphs: WORLD TÜRKİYE ECONOMY POLITICS ENERGY TECHNOLOGY Middle East Son of slain Hamas leader says family lost 75 members in Gaza war, calls Türkiye's political supporter of Palestine ‘He always advised us to remain among the people, for the people, and close to our family, neighbors and mosque,’ Abdul Salam Haniyeh says in interview for 2nd year of his father’s assassination Yusuf Alioğlu and Sahin Demir 02 August 2026 • Update : 02 August 2026 ISTANBUL ‘Türkiye stands with the Palestinian people under President Erdogan, and we feel we have political support from it,’ says Abdul Salam The message of the people must reach the tables of international political leaders to end the conflict, end the occupation and establish a Palestinian state,’ Abdu Abdul Salam Haniyeh, the son of slain Hamas Political Bureau chief Ismail Haniyeh, said more than 75 members of his immediate family and 250 members of the wider Al-Hajj clan have been killed during Israel’s war on the Gaza Strip.

In an interview with Anadolu marking the second year of his father’s assassination, Abdul Salam described Türkiye as “a political supporter of the Palestinian people,” praised President Recep Tayyip Erdogan’s backing of the Palestinian cause and expressed hope that mediation efforts by Egypt, Qatar and Türkiye would succeed in securing implementation of the Gaza ceasefire agreement.
Standing before a large family portrait hanging on the wall, Abdul Salam pointed to the faces of relatives killed during the war.

He identified Ismail Haniyeh’s three sons -- Mohammed, Hazem and Amir -- along with several grandchildren who were killed in an Israeli strike April 10, 2024, the first day of Eid al-Fitr, the Muslim holiday at the end of the holy month of Ramadan.
“More than 75 members of the Haniyeh family have been martyred during the war,” he said, adding that 250 members of the broader Al-Hajj clan had also been killed.

article.title: Drone strike in Egypt raises fears for shipping in Suez Canal
article.description: A drone attack on gas vessels at Egypt’s Mediterranean port of Damietta may signal a new phase in the conflict between the United States and Iran.
paragraphs: DUBAI, U.A.E: A drone attack on gas vessels at Egypt's Mediterranean port of Damietta may signal a new phase in the conflict between the United States and Iran. The incident has raised concerns about the safety of shipping near the Suez Canal, a key route for global trade and one of the last secure paths for Saudi oil exports.

Egypt's cabinet said on July 30 that early findings showed an unidentified drone caused a fire on two ships at Damietta port on July 29. The port lies close to the Suez Canal, which connects the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea.
Officials said no group had claimed responsibility for the attack. Authorities added that steps were being taken to protect the country's national security.
According to trading sources, the drone struck a U.S.-owned gas storage tanker called Energos Winter. The impact caused a fire that later spread to another nearby vessel.

The incident came amid rising tensions in the region. Overnight, the U.S. military carried out strikes on command centers and drone facilities linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guards. The attacks followed Iranian strikes on U.S. forces in the region.

article.description: The United States Central Command said it launched strikes against Iran following Tehran's attempted attacks on US forces in the Middle East, heightening concerns about a widening conflict that has dragged more countries into the fray this week.

The US command said its forces completed a heavy wave of strikes against Iran at 10 pm on Wednesday "in response to yesterday's attempted missile attacks on US forces".
The security situation continues to claim lives in the region.

article.description: The Muslim Council of Elders strongly condemns the attacks carried out by Israeli settlers against a number of villages in the occupied West Bank, mos.....
paragraphs: ABU DHABI, 27th July, 2026 (WAM) -- The Muslim Council of Elders strongly condemns the attacks carried out by Israeli settlers against a number of villages in the occupied West Bank, most recently the burning of a mosque in the city of Tulkarm.

The Council considers this crime a flagrant violation of the sanctity of places of worship, a provocation of the sentiments of Muslims, and a dangerous escalation that fuels the cycle of violence and extremism and undermines prospects for peace and stability.

The Muslim Council of Elders warns of the growing settler attacks against Palestinian civilians, their property, and their places of worship. The Council calls for the perpetrators to be held accountable and urges the international community to fulfill its legal and humanitarian responsibilities by taking urgent measures to halt violations committed under the Israeli occupation, provide the necessary protection for civilians, and safeguard Islamic and Christian holy sites.

The Council also reiterates its firm position calling for serious efforts to reach a just and comprehensive solution to the Palestinian cause, one that brings an end to the suffering of the Palestinian people, which has continued for more than seven decades, and guarantees their legitimate right to establish an independent, sovereign state with Jerusalem as its capital.
